text:
sam: spike idea: embed a compact, compressed shard index in a small header extension for safetensors so Bridge can schedule hot layers without an extra manifest.

li: sounds good for hosted cold-starts. keep it optionalfallback to sidecar if index too big. set header cap = 64KB.

gita: stream safety? header decompress must be non-blocking. propose incremental/coarse index pointers first so we can start top-N layers while decompress finishes.

sam: agree. flags: index_in_header, index_encrypted, incremental_index. shim maps all inputs to a ShardIndexDescriptor with chunk ranges and coarse fingerprints.

li: rollout: parse-only mode -> log unknown flags -> enable via feature-gate after 2 weeks. emit telemetry: header_decompress_ms, first_chunk_ms, verification_progress.

gita: add lease guards for warmup vs eviction: hydrate_lease with expiry + priority token. eviction consults lease.

warmup-bot: canary: header-index packer perf +12% median cold-start (n=300).

sam: I'll draft RFC + tiny packer CLI.
